searchText: There's the classic NSA conversation about it - we don't have a strong view for L1, giga supportive for every L2 to maximize authing flexibility so for L2 we have that done alrd as precompile and rdy to fire if there's momentum for L1 Can EL teams take a look at this change related to EIP-7702: https://github.com/ethereum/EIPs/pull/8679 Would assume we desire same order, but writing here for input/awareness. Ok for Besu, it's just a smol change OMG, why RLP? 🙂 What do you mean? Seems like June 26th, 14 UTC is most popular. Will create the agenda now! RLP is not necessary in this context. Simply bytes concatenation will do. There is only single use case of RLP in EVM: `CREATE` address derivation. Even `CREATE2` doesn't use RLP. EIP-7702 adds the second use-case. ChainID is variable length and nonce is optional, so that makes an encoding preferable. However all the data can be pulled from the transaction so a concatenation, even with the optional nonce, may produce the results we want. While I don't see a direct way to reliably exploit it, the concatenation may be subject to extension attacks if we don't encapsulate the components somehow, which RLP accomplishes. It ends up being basically the rlp encoding tbh, but custom for this IMO not that important, should just decide on something and do it as much as rlp is probably the worst encoding scheme on the planet, it works for this it isn’t in the EVM, it’s outside just like transactions are (which are rlp encoded for sig hash) I will implement RLP encoder for Pectra 😿 for what purpose?
